# Candidate experiment inputs

The Cursortab context patch applies to upstream revision
211f7159ecc9ec56c705cf5a486637f1221ad2fd of
[cursortab/cursortab.nvim](https://github.com/cursortab/cursortab.nvim).
The adjacent license is the upstream MIT license.

This is an optional cached-context prototype for a disposable checkout, not an
installed runtime dependency. It includes prompt and snapshot-isolation tests.
See [the candidate evaluation](../../docs/AI_CANDIDATES.md) for build commands,
experiment conditions and results.
